title: cli/serve: a --no-server boot prints "[datasource-admin] route registration failed: … a composition/ordering fault" when nothing is at fault; the plugin's own degrade line is unreachable because getService throws
body:
Filing gate **①**, class **(a)** (user-visible misleading text). `reach:` **measured at the public door** `objectstack serve objectstack.config.ts --no-server --preset minimal` (production, a host fixture), by #23744's dev on base `adce192974` and on `c29a1d1f90` (`os-dev-report` `6222472811`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). The seat re-read the code on `origin/main`.

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 1 (#6024) · `marchtian` · session `session_01PFB9ZGRWYvjhTXsd8i6KBp`, from that report. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

## What the operator reads

On a `--no-server` boot, the banner's boot diagnostics print:

```
WARN [datasource-admin] route registration failed: [Kernel] Service 'http.server' not found (while plugin 'com.objectstack.cli.datasource-admin-routes' was initializing — a composition/ordering fault; registration order is not a contract.)
```

Nothing is at fault. `--no-server` composed no HTTP server on purpose, so the datasource admin routes have nowhere to mount. The line tells the operator to look for an ordering bug that does not exist.

## Why, read on `origin/main`

- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, the `com.objectstack.cli.datasource-admin-routes` plugin (about `:5053`-`:5079`), `init` reads `ctx.getService?.('http.server') ?? ctx.getService?.('http-server')`. It means to fall through to its own degrade line, `[datasource-admin] http.server unavailable; REST routes not installed`, when no server is composed.
- `getService` THROWS on an unregistered name; it does not return `undefined`. The same file documents this trap at `:542` and `:711`, beside `readComposedHttpServer`. So the `??` never runs, the throw lands in the `catch`, and the `catch` prints "route registration failed" with the kernel's ordering-fault wording.
- The intended degrade line is unreachable on every boot without an HTTP server.

## Reader who acts

Triage grades and routes it. The landing is the plugin's `init` in `serve.ts` (`domain:cli`). One shape: read the server the way `readComposedHttpServer` does, so a boot without a server takes the plugin's own degrade line, and a real registration failure on a composed boot still warns. Pin the `--no-server` shape (no "route registration failed", no "ordering fault") and its control: a composed boot still mounts `/api/v1/datasources`.
